capabilities: Send an explicit query or editor selection to the configured sidecar endpoint
Trigger retrieval only when the sidecar's conservative trigger detects retrieval intent
Preview the returned read-injection block before using it
Copy or insert the injection block into the active note
Verify sidecar connectivity and display its detected status
extras: The plugin alone is not functional until the separately installed Python sidecar is running; the browse-sanyuan-nodes command exists only in builds from the pinned upstream commit, not in release 0.1.1. Non-loopback endpoints require an explicit settings opt-in, and the MIT license covers only this repository, not the sidecar or Sanyuan materials.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull relevant vault context from an external retrieval pipeline and inject it into the note being written.

relations.evidence: Retrieval, embeddings, reranking, database access, and Sanyuan topology processing run in a separate Python sidecar.

summary: Retrieval client that sends a query or editor selection to a Sanyuan-compatible sidecar and inserts the returned context block into notes.
